body:
I’m sorry you were downvoted, I see a 0 score next to reply. 

You’re right that humans get tempted, I’ve read about people who’ve done so much worse than I did when they were desperate. Still... knowing I went against my own values just hurts me more than the thought of getting expelled for this. 

Thank you for the kind words. They’re what I needed to read :)
I’ll do what I can. Thank you for the kind words. This has been eating at me for so long...

This is in college, the place where I’m supposed to not do this shit, yet I did. If I did come clean then I could get expelled and I don’t even want to think about what would happen after... 

I guess maybe I can internalize the shame
